title: NumTrace: Auditing the Number Provenance of Financial Analyst Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34887v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A numerical claim generated by a financial analyst agent can match a number in a company filing but refer to the wrong entity, concept, period, unit or scope. A check based on reference answers can mark such an answer as wrong but does not explain why it fails. In this paper, we present NumTrace, a new benchmark that audits the provenance of each numerical claim made by financial analyst agents: its source and financial semantics. NumTrace currently has 540 questions over 2,163 SEC EDGAR documents. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first numerical benchmark about who holds a company's shares (Form 13F) and what its executives are owed (Item 402(i)). On a frozen snapshot of these documents, we build the reference answers according to accounting rules. NumTrace then gives each claim three separate verdicts: value, binding and support. translated_title: NumTrace：审计金融分析师智能体的数字溯源
translated_abstract: 金融分析师智能体生成的数字论断可能在公司申报文件中匹配到某个数字，但其所指的实体、概念、期间、单位或范围却是错误的。基于参考答案的检查方法虽然能将此类答案标记为错误，却无法解释其失败的原因。本文提出了 NumTrace，一个用于审计金融分析师智能体所做每个数字论断溯源的新基准，即审计其来源与财务语义。NumTrace 目前包含针对 2,163 份 SEC EDGAR 文档的 540 个问题。据我们所知，这是首个关于谁持有公司股份（13F 表格）以及公司高管应得薪酬（Item 402(i) 条款）的数值基准。我们基于这些文档的冻结快照，按照会计规则构建参考答案。NumTrace 对每个论断给出三项独立判定：数值、绑定和支持。通过将数值判定与绑定判定分开保留，NumTrace 能够检测出“数字正确但科目错误”（RN）这类问题。
tldr: 提出首个审计金融分析师智能体数字论断溯源（来源与财务语义）的基准 NumTrace，基于 2,163 份 SEC EDGAR 文档构建 540 个问题，通过数值、绑定、支持三项独立判定来检测“数字正确但归属错误”等问题。
